pr_title: Expand expressions to include parentheses in E712
pr_body:
## Summary

This PR exposes our `is_expression_parenthesized` logic such that we can use it to expand expressions when autofixing to include their parenthesized ranges.

This solution has a few drawbacks: (1) we need to compute parenthesized ranges in more places, which also relies on backwards lexing; and (2) we need to make use of this in any relevant fixes.

However, I still think it's worth pursuing. On (1), the implementation is very contained, so IMO we can easily swap this out for a more performant solution in the future if needed. On (2), this improves correctness and fixes some bad syntax errors detected by fuzzing, which means it has value even if it's not as robust as an _actual_ `ParenthesizedExpression` node in the AST itself.

Closes https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/issues/4925.

## Test Plan

`cargo test` with new cases that previously failed the fuzzer.

issue_context.title: E712: Invalid parentheses removal
issue_context.body:
E712 fix may remove parentheses in a way which causes invalid syntax:

```py
def a(x):
  return x == 5

if(a(2)) == True:
  print("it's five")
```

Becomes:

```py
def a(x):
  return x == 5

ifa(2) is True:
  print("it's five")
```

Discovered by #4822.

Thanks for the ping. Mutating the tree instead of manually creating text edits would solve that too
Ideally the edit would be "just" replacing `==` with `is`, rather than rewriting the entire expression :joy:

Sadly would not work for the opposite reason:
```py
if a==True:
  ...
```

would become
```py
if aisTrue:
  ...
```

Just repro'ed another version of this w/ #4822 in libafl mode 😁


> Which is invalid because the `yield` must be surrounded by parentheses. I think the answer to this is to simply _not_ remove the parentheses, as it seems to be not a totally sane fix.

This seems like a regression as I can only reproduce this on `v0.0.279` onwards and not on any previous versions.

A bisection search gives me 875e04e36900114a3b7fdefe84e5ea9c4afdb5b7.

Right, so the patch generation was moved from `Generator`-based to `Locator`-based which is not aware of the parenthesis while the `Generator`-based is.
